summary: This is a purely additive, archive-only data cataloging change following the exact pattern already established by batch1/batch2: two new standalone scripts (merge_xpost_github_catalog_batch3.py, register_xpost_github_catalog_batch3.py) plus the resulting edit to ai-os/XPOST_GITHUB_CATALOG_2026-07-24.yaml adding 8 new repo rows and 5 new checked_no_repo rows. The merge script correctly resolves the repo-root catalog path, guards against repo_path collisions with existing batches before appending, and the diff's resulting meta counters (repo_count 53->61, checked_no_repo_count 7->12, total_source_tweet_urls 37->50) are internally consistent with the added rows. No source_tweet_url values are fabricated for the un-itemized aggregate instruction; the Zipstack/unstract repost is correctly deduped rather than re-added as a row. The register script uses subprocess with list-form args (no shell injection risk) to call the existing superboss-register.py CLI for tag/relationship/annotation updates on the already-registered knowledge_engine row, avoiding a duplicate registry row. No migrations, schema, auth, permission/payment/billing/rls/security paths, or .github/workflows/** files are touched, so tier1 classification is correct and no hard-rule violation applies.
